snippet.title: PARANORMASIGHT: The Mermaid's Curse – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
PARANORMASIGHT: The Mermaid's Curse is coming to Nintendo Switch on Feb 19, 2026. Pre-order today: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/paranormasight-the-mermaids-curse-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

A brand new PARANORMASIGHT tale begins in Ise-Shima, Japan—a region rich in mermaid legends.

Join a cast of fascinating characters investigating the mysteries of the Mermaids of Ise. Unravel their different perspectives on the case and guide the story to its thrilling conclusion.

#PARNORMASIGHT #NintendoSwitch #NintendoDirect 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Subscribe for more Nintendo fun: https://goo.gl/HYYsot
